lines.text: In mid-2010s Oklahoma, Amy is outed and fired from the Christian bakery where she works, leading her to an unintentional new gig as a professional bridesmaid. Mix wedding hijinks, a charmingly grungy queer bar, Amy’s loving friend group, and the cute and intriguing new girl in town, and you have a recipe for a delicious romcom. This is a delightful debut from local author Dumond.
